verified: The Ruby core team rates a heap-based buffer overflow in Ruby's string case conversion as critical, tracked as CVE-2026-132825 and dubbed "ruby2ßhell"; it says changing the case of a crafted string may allow remote code execution, that proof-of-concept exploits can trigger code execution in some scenarios, and that patched versions have been released, per Cybersecurity News and Orca Security.
unconfirmed: That the flaw gives pre-authentication RCE on stock, unmodified Rails applications — that framing comes from the Veria Labs blog post rather than the CVE description — along with the specific fixed version numbers and any independent reproduction; commenters also note the write-up overlaps substantially with a separate Ruby advisory covering six other vulnerabilities.

verified: 据 ORCA Security 与 Cybersecurity News 的报道，Ruby 字符串大小写转换中的堆缓冲区溢出已被分配编号 CVE-2026-132825，代号“ruby2ßhell”；Ruby 核心团队将其评为 critical（严重），并称对特制字符串做大小写转换可能导致远程代码执行，且已知存在能在部分场景触发代码执行的验证性利用（proof-of-concept）；相关修复已发布。
unconfirmed: Verial Labs 博文所称“在未改动的原版 Rails 上可预认证远程代码执行”的完整利用链与稳定复现，尚无独立第三方验证；Hacker News 评论者指出该问题已被另一份涵盖另外六个漏洞的 Ruby 安全公告覆盖，本次披露的新增信息有限；补丁的具体版本号、受影响版本范围与发布时间在现有报道中均未明确。
